cues.en: Welcome to Awakening Celebrations. Take a moment to settle in. When you are ready, review how the experience works and begin.
cues.zh: 歡迎來到覺醒慶典。請先放鬆一下。準備好後，就閱讀體驗說明，開始探索。

cues.en: Please read the privacy information before deciding whether to allow camera tracking for this visit.
cues.zh: 使用相機追蹤前，請先閱讀隱私說明，再決定是否授予本次體驗的許可。

cues.en: Six artistic worlds are waiting to meet you. These short steps show the gestures and the available mouse and keyboard controls.
cues.zh: 六個藝術世界正等著與你相遇。接下來會介紹手勢，以及可用的滑鼠與鍵盤操作。

cues.en: Point toward the presence that catches your attention. Pointing highlights your choice. Make a fist to confirm, or click a portrait.
cues.zh: 指向吸引你注意的那位存在。指向只會標示目標；握拳即可確認，也可以點擊肖像。

cues.en: Wave your hand gently from side to side to awaken the gallery, or use the button on screen.
cues.zh: 輕輕左右揮手，喚醒藝廊。你也可以使用畫面上的按鈕。

cues.en: Explore the six presences at your own pace. Choose the one you would like to meet.
cues.zh: 依照自己的步調，探索六種存在。選擇你最想相遇的那一位。

cues.en: Take a breath. What stayed with you? If you like, ask a question about what you experienced. You can read the reply, or choose to listen when audio is available.
cues.zh: 深呼吸。剛才的體驗，有什麼留在你心裡？如果你願意，可以提出一個問題。你可以閱讀回覆，或在有語音時選擇朗讀。

cues.en: Thank you for spending this moment with us. Take whatever stayed with you into the rest of your day.
cues.zh: 謝謝你與我們共度這一刻。把留在心裡的感受，帶進接下來的生活。
